cpu.evidence: esp32sim commit implements Xtensa LX7 FPU decoder/interpreter/JIT and S3 two-core control; performance is unmeasured

flash_psram.evidence: Wasm ABI accepts up to 32 MiB each for flash and PSRAM; target 32+8 MiB fits the stated individual caps

co5300_display.evidence: CO5300 panel model exists; current 1.8-inch board config is 368x448 and x-offset 16

ft3168_touch.evidence: Waveshare FT3x68 driver identifies FT3168 as 0x03 at A0 and reads finger count 0x02 plus X/Y records from 0x03/0x05; board model exposes that map at I2C 0x38, injects active-low GPIO38 IRQ, and clears contacts on active-low GPIO9 reset. Gesture and power-mode behavior remain unmodeled.

qmi8658_imu.evidence: QMI8658 adapter exposes injected motion, not sensor register/IRQ fidelity

pmu_rtc.evidence: current 1.8 board uses Reg8 initialization stubs for AXP2101 and PCF85063

i2s.evidence: S3 models I2S/GDMA streams; board codec and amplifier are not thereby modeled

es8311_es7210.evidence: no board-specific ES8311 playback or ES7210 capture device found
